_note: sc-console-playwright manual-test-case convention. Extra fields (_schema, covers) are ignored by their generator.ts but drive our coverage gate + EC traceability. 109 EC consolidated into 35 checks.

sources.notes: Consolidated manual pass across UC1a/UC1b/UC2/UC3. All platforms (iOS, Android, web-desktop, mobile-web). Derived from the qa-assistant EC pipeline (phase-3-4); every EC is traced in cases[].covers.

cases.name: [ Reveal controls ] Verify first tap reveals the controls overlay without toggling playback
cases.preconditions:
A recorded video or recorded live stream (VOD) is open on the target device
The controls overlay is hidden
The video is playing
steps: Tap the center of the screen once
expectedResults: Before the first tap, no controls overlay is shown
The first tap reveals the controls overlay
Playback is unaffected — the video keeps playing
The first tap is not a no-op and does not pause

cases.name: [ Dismiss overlay ] Verify tapping outside the button dismisses the overlay without pausing
cases.preconditions:
A recorded video or recorded live stream (VOD) is open on the target device
The controls overlay is hidden
The video is playing
steps: Tap outside the center button (empty area)
expectedResults: The controls overlay dismisses
The video keeps playing
Tapping outside never pauses the video

cases.name: [ Auto-dismiss ] Verify the overlay auto-dismisses about 1 second after the last interaction
cases.preconditions:
A recorded video or recorded live stream (VOD) is open on the target device
The controls overlay is hidden
The video is playing
steps: Do not touch anything and wait
expectedResults: The overlay auto-dismisses after about 1 second
The overlay does not linger for 3 seconds

cases.name: [ Pause ] Verify the center button pauses a recorded video and shows the seek controls
cases.preconditions:
A recorded video or recorded live stream (VOD) is open on the target device
The controls overlay is hidden
The video is playing
expectedResults: The video pauses
A [ play icon ] is shown
The [ ±10s seek buttons ] are present (recorded content)
The paused overlay persists

cases.name: [ Paused state ] Verify the paused overlay persists and tapping outside does not resume
cases.preconditions:
A recorded video or recorded live stream (VOD) is open on the target device
The controls overlay is hidden
The video is playing
expectedResults: The paused overlay does not auto-dismiss on the 1s idle timer
Tapping outside while paused does not resume playback
The video stays paused

cases.name: [ Resume ] Verify resuming continues from the exact paused position
cases.description: Recorded-LS resume position is an open assumption — observe, do not fail the case on it
cases.preconditions:
A recorded video or recorded live stream (VOD) is open on the target device
The controls overlay is hidden
The video is playing
steps: Note the timecode where the video is paused
Tap the [ play button ] to resume
expectedResults: Playback resumes from the same position
The video does not restart from the beginning

cases.name: [ Auto-dismiss ] Verify a control interaction resets the 1 second auto-dismiss countdown
cases.preconditions:
A recorded video or recorded live stream (VOD) is open on the target device
The controls overlay is hidden
The video is playing
steps: Wait about half a second, then tap a control once
expectedResults: The interaction restarts the ~1s countdown
The overlay stays visible because there was interaction

cases.name: [ Race ] Verify a pause tap wins against the auto-dismiss timer
cases.preconditions:
A recorded video or recorded live stream (VOD) is open on the target device
The controls overlay is hidden
The video is playing
steps: Tap pause exactly as the overlay is about to dismiss
expectedResults: The pause registers
The expiring timer does not swallow the pause

cases.name: [ Buffering ] Verify tapping during buffering shows the real loading state
cases.preconditions:
A recorded video or recorded live stream (VOD) is open on the target device
The network can be throttled to force buffering
steps: Throttle the network or seek to an unloaded point to force buffering
expectedResults: A real loading / buffering state is shown
The center button does not show a false [ play icon ]

cases.name: [ Backgrounding ] Verify backgrounding pauses playback and does not auto-resume
cases.preconditions:
A recorded video or recorded live stream (VOD) is open on the target device
The controls overlay is hidden
The video is playing
steps: While playing, send the app to the background
Repeat while the video is paused
expectedResults: Backgrounding while playing pauses via the OS and dismisses the overlay
Returning to the foreground does not auto-resume
Backgrounding while paused keeps it paused

cases.name: [ Surface parity ] Verify reveal, dismiss, pause and resume behave the same on every surface
cases.preconditions:
A recorded video or recorded live stream (VOD) is open on the target device
The controls overlay is hidden
The video is playing
steps: Repeat reveal / dismiss / pause / resume on each surface (feed player, fullscreen)
expectedResults: Behaviour is identical on every surface
No surface diverges

cases.name: [ Skip ] Verify the ±10s buttons skip about 10 seconds while playing
cases.preconditions:
A recorded video or recorded live stream (VOD) is open on the target device
The controls overlay is hidden
The video is playing
steps: Return to 1:00 and tap the [ +10s button ]
expectedResults: −10s jumps to about 0:50
+10s jumps to about 1:10
Each skip moves about 10 seconds

cases.name: [ Skip boundary ] Verify skip-back near the start clamps to 0:00
cases.preconditions:
A recorded video or recorded live stream (VOD) is open on the target device
The controls overlay is hidden
The video is playing
expectedResults: Skip-back near the start clamps to 0:00
At 0:00 it stays at 0:00
The clamp behaves the same while paused

cases.name: [ Skip boundary ] Verify skip-forward at the end stops on the final frame without looping
cases.preconditions:
A recorded video or recorded live stream (VOD) is open on the target device
The controls overlay is hidden
The video is playing
expectedResults: Playback lands on the final frame
It does not loop back to 0:00
No error is thrown

cases.name: [ Skip while paused ] Verify skipping while paused updates the position and stays paused
cases.preconditions:
A recorded video or recorded live stream (VOD) is open on the target device
The controls overlay is hidden
The video is playing
expectedResults: The position moves
The video stays paused
It does not auto-resume

cases.name: [ Skip controls ] Verify the skip buttons appear only after the overlay is revealed
cases.preconditions: A recorded video and a recorded live stream (VOD) are available on the target device
steps: Open a [ recorded LS ] and a [ recorded video ]
Check before revealing the overlay, then after
expectedResults: Recorded LS and recorded video show the skip buttons
Before the overlay is revealed there are no skip buttons
After revealing the overlay the skip buttons appear

cases.name: [ Rapid skip ] Verify rapid repeated skips accumulate correctly
cases.preconditions:
A recorded video or recorded live stream (VOD) is open on the target device
The controls overlay is hidden
The video is playing
steps: Burst near the start and near the end
expectedResults: Three +10s taps reach about 1:30
Three −10s taps move about −30 seconds
The skip icon does not display the accumulated total
A burst near the start clamps at 0:00 and near the end stops at the end

cases.name: [ Buffering ] Verify skipping while buffering on mobile seeks and rebuffers
cases.preconditions:
A recorded video or recorded live stream (VOD) is open on the target device
The network can be throttled to force buffering
expectedResults: The player seeks and rebuffers
No frozen frame is left without an indicator

cases.name: [ Buffering ] Verify web buffering shows the reconnecting UI and keeps manual scrub
cases.description: ±10s result mid-buffer on web is an open follow-up (FU-3) — observe, do not assert
cases.preconditions:
A recorded video or recorded live stream (VOD) is open on the target device
The network can be throttled to force buffering
expectedResults: Web shows a [ Reconnecting ] UI
Manual scrub stays available

cases.name: [ Reveal controls ] Verify first tap on a live stream reveals controls without pausing
cases.preconditions: A live stream is broadcasting and open on the target device
steps: Open a live stream that is broadcasting
Observe before tapping ([ LIVE badge ] + viewer count present)
expectedResults: Before the first tap, no controls overlay is shown
The first tap reveals the controls overlay
The live stream keeps playing (no pause, not a no-op)

cases.name: [ Dismiss overlay ] Verify tapping outside dismisses the live overlay without pausing
cases.preconditions: A live stream is broadcasting and open on the target device
steps: With the overlay shown on live
expectedResults: The overlay dismisses
The live stream keeps playing
Tapping outside does not pause

cases.name: [ Auto-dismiss ] Verify the live overlay auto-dismisses about 1 second after the last interaction
cases.preconditions: A live stream is broadcasting and open on the target device
expectedResults: The overlay dismisses after about 1 second
It does not linger for 3 seconds

cases.name: [ Pause ] Verify pausing a live stream shows no seek controls and the overlay persists
cases.preconditions: A live stream is broadcasting and open on the target device
steps: Tap outside the button while paused
expectedResults: A [ play icon ] persists
No [ ±10s seek buttons ] are shown (live content)
The paused overlay does not auto-dismiss
Tapping outside keeps it paused

cases.name: [ Surface parity ] Verify live reveal, dismiss, auto-dismiss and pause behave the same on every surface
cases.preconditions: A live stream is broadcasting and open on the target device
steps: Repeat reveal / dismiss / auto-dismiss / pause on each live surface
expectedResults: Behaviour is identical on every surface

cases.name: [ Race ] Verify a pause tap wins against the auto-dismiss timer on live
cases.preconditions: A live stream is broadcasting and open on the target device
steps: Tap a control to restart the countdown
Tap pause as the overlay is about to dismiss
expectedResults: The countdown restarts on interaction
A pause tap at the dismiss instant wins
The expiring timer does not swallow the pause

cases.name: [ Buffering ] Verify live buffering shows the real state and no false play icon
cases.preconditions:
A live stream is broadcasting on the target device
The network can be throttled to force buffering
steps: Force live buffering, then tap the screen
expectedResults: Tapping during buffering shows the real state
A stall surfaces a buffering / [ Reconnecting ] state
The center button never shows a false [ play icon ]

cases.name: [ Backgrounding ] Verify backgrounding a live stream resolves to the OS-default state
cases.preconditions: A live stream is broadcasting and open on the target device
steps: Background the app while the overlay / timer is active
expectedResults: It resolves to the OS-default state
No stale overlay or false toggle remains
Foreground snap-to-live is observed only (do not assert)

cases.name: [ Pause ] Verify pausing a live stream shows the play overlay and keeps chat live
cases.preconditions: A live stream with active chat is broadcasting on the target device
steps: Watch live at the live edge
Observe the default (no pause indicator, [ LIVE badge ], viewer count, chat)
Tap the [ play button ] to resume (not tap-outside)
expectedResults: Pausing shows the [ ▶ overlay ]
Chat stays live while paused
No [ ±10s seek ] is shown
The ▶ overlay is the only pause indicator
Tapping the play button resumes

cases.name: [ Resume ] Verify resuming a paused live stream seeks to about the live edge
cases.preconditions: A live stream is broadcasting and open on the target device
steps: Pause live and hold for a moment
expectedResults: Resume jumps to about the live edge (within tolerance)
It does not return to the paused offset and is not exact-live
The overlay dismisses and chat stays continuous

cases.name: [ Pause control ] Verify the pause control matches each platform
cases.preconditions: A live stream is broadcasting and open on the target device
steps: Open a live stream on each platform
expectedResults: mobile-web shows no pause control
web-desktop offers a 1-step pause
iOS and Android use a 2-step pause (reveal then pause)

cases.name: [ Stream end ] Verify ending the room during a pause resolves to the ended state
cases.preconditions:
A live stream is broadcasting on the target device
A host / second device can end the room
steps: Pause live, then have the host end the room
Try: recording not ready / room becomes recorded / pause and end at the same time
expectedResults: Ending the room while paused enters the ended state with no frozen frame
A not-ready recording shows 'Livestream ended' with no processing state
A recorded room shows the recorded / VOD state
A simultaneous pause + end resolves to ended (terminal wins)

cases.name: [ Chat sync ] Verify chat and video realign at the live moment on resume
cases.preconditions: A live stream with active chat is broadcasting on the target device
steps: Keep chat messages flowing during the pause
Note message ids before and after
expectedResults: Chat and video realign at the live moment with no replay and no skip
Message ids show no duplicate and no gap
After a long paused window chat is already at the live moment

cases.name: [ Network ] Verify a network drop while paused stays paused and does not auto-resume
cases.preconditions:
A live stream is broadcasting on the target device
The device network can be toggled on/off
steps: Cut the network, wait, then restore it
expectedResults: A drop while paused shows [ Reconnecting ] and stays paused through recovery
On recovery it resumes to about the live edge
It never auto-resumes when the network returns
iOS shows a Reconnecting scrim even while paused; web shows the overlay only on broadcaster waitingReconnect

cases.name: [ Long pause ] Verify a multi-minute pause still resumes to about the live edge
cases.preconditions:
A live stream is broadcasting on the target device
The test needs several minutes of real elapsed time
steps: Pause live for several minutes (try different jump sizes)
expectedResults: After many minutes it still resumes to about the live edge within tolerance
The jump size does not change the guarantee
Being further behind still lands within the guarantee

cases.name: [ Live vs recorded ] Verify live has no seek or skip controls unlike recorded
cases.preconditions: Both a live stream (broadcasting) and a recorded video are available on the target device
steps: On live, check the seek / skip buttons
Pause and resume on live and compare the position
expectedResults: Live shows no [ ±10s seek buttons ] (unlike recorded)
Resume on live goes to the live edge, not the paused position
Live shows no in-app skip buttons

cases.name: [ Skip controls ] Verify a clip shows no ±10s skip buttons
cases.description: Edge case (review 2026-07-12) — clip is a distinct content type, not in the UC1a–3 EC set (no EC backing)
cases.preconditions: A clip (short-form vertical video) is open on a mobile device (clips are not supported on web)
expectedResults: A clip shows no [ ±10s skip buttons ] (a clip is not a seekable video / VOD)
Neither skip-forward nor skip-back is present

cases.name: [ Surface parity ] Verify a Live stream behaves identically whether created in Newsfeed, Community, or Event
cases.description: Edge case (review 2026-07-12) — the 3 LS-live creation surfaces (Newsfeed/Community/Event) are not in the EC set (no EC backing)
cases.preconditions: A Live stream can be created / opened from Newsfeed, from a Community, and from an Event
steps: Open a Live stream created in [ Newsfeed ] — reveal, pause, resume
Repeat on a Live stream created in a [ Community ]
Repeat on a Live stream created in an [ Event ]
expectedResults: Reveal, pause and resume behave identically across Newsfeed, Community, and Event
The live player works regardless of where the stream was created
No surface-specific difference in pause / resume-to-live
